use_when.en: Use for an original character sheet that must preserve identity, costume construction, proportions, and readable turnaround views.
use_when.zh: 用于需要稳定人物身份、服装结构、比例和多视图一致性的原创角色设定表。

en: Define a short set of unmistakable identity anchors before layout decisions.
Use a restrained editorial grid with consistent scale and baselines across views.
Specify exact labels and forbid all other visible text when typography matters.
Check anatomy, costume continuity, left-right orientation, and expression consistency separately.
zh: 先定义少量不可混淆的人物身份锚点，再决定版式。
使用克制的编辑网格，并保持各视图比例和基线一致。
文字重要时明确逐字标签，并禁止出现其他可见文字。
分别检查人体、服装连续性、左右方向和表情一致性。

use_when.en: Use for a photorealistic multi-look fashion board that must preserve one adult identity, complete full-body framing, and clearly differentiated wardrobe capsules.
use_when.zh: 用于需要在多套写实穿搭中保持同一成年人物身份、完整全身构图和清楚服装差异的时装板。

en: Define one fictional adult identity with a compact set of stable face, hair, skin, age, and body anchors.
Use a fixed grid, equal figure scale, aligned floor lines, and complete head-to-shoe framing.
Differentiate each wardrobe capsule by silhouette, garment type, palette, footwear, and only essential accessories.
Review identity, anatomy, outfit count, cell count, and visible text as separate acceptance gates.
zh: 用精简而稳定的面部、发型、肤色、年龄和身体锚点定义一个虚构成年人物。
使用固定网格、统一人物比例、对齐地面线，并保证从头到鞋完整可见。
通过轮廓、服装类型、色板、鞋履和必要配件区分每套穿搭。
将身份、人体、服装数量、格子数量和可见文字作为独立验收门禁。

use_when.en: Use for a finished product launch visual with controlled geometry, material rendering, copy space, and semantic annotations.
use_when.zh: 用于需要准确产品几何、材质表现、文案空间和语义标注的成品级商业发布视觉。

en: Lock object count, geometry, materials, and forbidden additions before styling.
Reserve copy space explicitly and keep the product silhouette dominant.
Connect each callout to the exact feature it describes.
Separate generated visual material from deterministic typography when exact pixels or text are required.
zh: 先锁定物体数量、几何、材质和禁止新增项，再处理风格。
明确预留文案空间，并保持产品轮廓为主视觉。
每条标注线都必须准确指向对应功能区域。
需要精确像素或文字时，将生成素材与确定性排版分离。

use_when.en: Use for an original visual-first poster plate that needs one strong graphic anchor, a secondary focal point, controlled material and color, and calm zones reserved for exact typography added later.
use_when.zh: 用于需要单一强视觉锚点、次级焦点、受控材质与配色，并为后续精确排版预留安静区域的原创视觉优先海报底板。

en: Define one original visual anchor and one subordinate counterpoint before adding atmosphere, texture, or secondary decoration.
Reserve title and credit zones explicitly, then keep them free of generated letters, pseudo-text, branding, and visual noise.
Use a small disciplined palette and material-specific evidence such as paper fibers, folds, ink grain, or real contact shadow rather than generic polish words.
Treat generated imagery as the visual plate; add exact title, date, venue, and credits only through deterministic composition after the visual asset passes review.
zh: 在添加氛围、纹理或次级装饰前，先定义一个原创视觉锚点和一个从属的对位焦点。
明确预留标题与制作信息区域，并保持其中没有生成文字、伪文字、品牌和视觉噪声。
使用小而克制的色板及纸纤维、折痕、油墨颗粒或真实接触阴影等材质证据，而不是泛泛的精致词。
把生成图像定位为视觉底板；视觉资产通过复核后，标题、日期、地点和制作信息只通过确定性排版加入。

use_when.en: Use for a photorealistic product breakdown that must make internal components, assembly logic, materials, and part hierarchy easy to inspect.
use_when.zh: 用于需要清楚检查内部部件、装配逻辑、材质和层级关系的写实产品分解图。

en: Declare one fictional product and enumerate its functional layers before specifying style.
Lock the center axis, layer order, symmetry, spacing, and which modules may sit off-axis.
Describe material and assembly plausibility separately from visual polish.
Generate the hardware without copy; add exact part names, leader lines, and headings through deterministic composition.
zh: 先定义一个虚构产品并枚举功能层，再说明视觉风格。
锁定中心轴、层级顺序、左右对称、间距和允许偏轴的模块。
将材质与装配可信度和视觉精致度分开描述。
硬件生成阶段不生成文字；逐字部件名、引线和标题使用确定性排版补充。

use_when.en: Use for a photorealistic indoor editorial portrait that needs a calm adult subject, natural seated body language, modest styling, soft light, and unforced negative space.
use_when.zh: 用于需要安静成年主体、自然坐姿、端庄穿搭、柔和光线和克制留白的写实室内编辑人像。

en: State the fictional adult age, identity boundary, and non-sexualized presentation before pose or mood.
Specify complete hands, stable seated anatomy, modest layered clothing, and visible material texture separately.
Use one restrained room surface and one soft directional light source so the pose and negative space stay legible.
Describe a quiet off-camera gaze and observed body language rather than glamour or campaign posing.
zh: 在姿势和情绪前，先明确虚构成年年龄、身份边界和非性感化表达。
分别约束完整双手、稳定坐姿人体、端庄叠穿和可见材质纹理。
使用一个克制的室内表面和一处柔和定向光，让姿势与留白都清楚。
描述安静的非直视视线和被观察到的身体语言，而非广告或性感摆拍。

use_when.en: Use for a photorealistic full-body people image that needs one adult subject in believable, grounded motion without becoming a sports advertisement, campaign key art, or static portrait.
use_when.zh: 用于需要一位成年主体、完整全身和可信动态的写实人物图像，同时避免体育广告化、宣传主视觉化或静态肖像感。

en: Define a fictional adult identity and non-sexualized presentation before describing movement or mood.
State the planted foot, lifted limb, torso rotation, and counterbalancing arms so the requested action has a legible center of gravity.
Keep both hands, both shoes, wrists, knees, and ankles visible enough to inspect independently.
Use modest unbranded wardrobe, real material wear, and a restrained exterior context; avoid team styling, campaign posing, and heroic exaggeration.
zh: 先明确虚构成年身份和非性感化表达，再描述动作和情绪。
明确落地脚、抬起的肢体、躯干旋转和用于平衡的双臂，使动作具有清楚的重心。
让双手、双鞋、手腕、膝盖和脚踝都足够可见，以便分别检查。
使用端庄无品牌服装、真实材质磨损和克制的室外环境；避免队服感、广告摆拍和英雄式夸张。

use_when.en: Use for a photorealistic observed portrait where one adult person must perform a specific hands-on craft action with credible hands, object contact, material behavior, and working context.
use_when.zh: 用于需要一位成年人物完成具体手作动作，并同时保证双手、物体接触、材质行为和工作环境可信的写实纪实人像。

en: Define one fictional adult, the single object being worked, and a non-sexualized working presentation before styling.
Name each hand's relationship to the object, the support surface, wrist visibility, and complete lower-body framing.
Use material-specific evidence such as fingerprints, dust, tool wear, moisture, fibers, and surface irregularities.
Direct the scene as observed process rather than a lifestyle campaign, product display, or influencer pose.
zh: 先定义一位虚构成年主体、唯一操作对象和非性感化的工作表达，再处理风格。
明确每只手与对象的关系、支撑面、手腕可见性和完整下半身构图。
使用指纹、粉尘、工具磨损、湿度、纤维和表面不规则等材质证据。
把场景定位为被观察到的过程，而不是生活方式广告、产品展示或网红摆拍。

title.zh: 写实音乐排练纪实人像

use_when.en: Use for a photorealistic observed portrait where one adult must interact credibly with one complex acoustic instrument, including complete body, hands, object scale, and instrument structure.
use_when.zh: 用于需要一位成年人物与一件复杂原声乐器可信交互的写实纪实人像，并保证完整身体、双手、物体比例和乐器结构。

en: Define one fictional adult, one instrument, and all complete parts that must remain readable.
Specify both hands, the instrument contact points, full framing, and physical scale before choosing mood.
Constrain construction details that establish instrument identity, then inspect them separately from the person.
Keep rehearsal context observed and unbranded; avoid concert-poster lighting and album-cover glamour.
zh: 先定义一位虚构成年主体、一件乐器和必须清楚可见的完整部件。
在选择情绪前，明确双手、人与乐器接触点、完整构图和物理比例。
约束用于识别乐器的结构细节，并与人物质量分开检查。
让排练环境保持被观察到且无品牌；避免演出海报灯光和专辑封面式摆拍。

use_when.en: Use for a respectful photorealistic environmental portrait of a mature adult where natural age detail, complete anatomy, practical wardrobe, and a credible non-promotional outdoor context must remain visible.
use_when.zh: 用于需要尊重成熟成年主体自然年龄特征、完整人体、实用服装和可信非宣传式户外环境的写实环境纪实人像。

en: State that the subject is a fictional adult with a specific mature age and preserve visible age detail before describing wardrobe or mood.
Describe both complete hands, their object or support contacts, full standing framing, and boots as independently inspectable constraints.
Use ordinary unbranded field clothing, believable weather and surface evidence, and an observed environmental context rather than travel or luxury styling.
Treat respect as a visual constraint: avoid youthification, beauty retouching, heroic adventure, and stereotypes while keeping the subject's role concrete.
zh: 先明确主体是具有具体成熟年龄的虚构成年人，并在服装和情绪之前保留可见年龄特征。
将完整双手、与物体或支撑面的接触、完整站姿和鞋靴定义为可独立检查的约束。
使用普通无品牌的户外工作服、可信天气与表面证据和被观察到的环境，而非旅行或奢侈品风格。
把尊重作为视觉约束：避免年轻化、美颜精修、英雄冒险化和刻板印象，同时保持角色职责具体。

use_when.en: Use for a photorealistic comparison board where one fictional adult identity must remain stable across many equal portrait cells while only hairstyle changes.
use_when.zh: 用于需要在多个等比例人像格中保持同一虚构成年身份稳定、仅改变发型的写实对比板。

en: Lock a concise adult identity anchor set before enumerating hairstyles: face geometry, age, skin detail, expression, wardrobe, crop, and backdrop.
State that hair is the sole intended variable and specify which attributes may change: length, cut, part, texture, and tied or loose styling.
Use one strict grid, equal eye line, stable shoulder scale, neutral studio background, and constant light so comparison remains legible.
Prefer visual comparison without labels; add exact style names later through deterministic layout if named cells are required.
zh: 在列举发型前，先锁定精简的成年身份锚点：面部几何、年龄、皮肤细节、表情、服装、裁切和背景。
明确发型是唯一允许变化的变量，并限定可变化属性：长度、剪裁、分缝、纹理以及束起或披散造型。
使用严格网格、统一视平线、稳定肩部比例、中性影棚背景和恒定光线，使对比始终清楚。
优先使用无标签的视觉对比；如必须命名格子，后续通过确定性排版加入准确名称。

use_when.en: Use for a restrained photorealistic head-and-shoulders portrait of one fictional adult man where controlled warm studio color, clear eyes, natural age detail, skin, beard, and wardrobe material must all remain credible without luxury-campaign polish.
use_when.zh: 用于需要一位虚构成年男性的克制写实头肩影棚人像，并要求受控暖色、清晰双眼、自然年龄细节、皮肤、胡须和服装材质都可信，且不呈现奢侈品广告式精修。

en: Declare one fictional adult identity, a specific adult age, clear-eye requirement, full crown-and-chin frame boundary, and no real-person reference before describing aesthetic detail.
Use a plain seamless studio field, a small disciplined palette, broad warm key light, and only enough cool edge separation to preserve silhouette; let material evidence carry the realism.
Name inspectable skin, beard, and wardrobe details such as pores, faint under-eye texture, individual beard hairs, brushed cotton, knit ribbing, and seams.
Keep the resulting portrait observational and unbranded; exclude sunglasses, jewelry, campaign styling, beauty smoothing, and exaggerated color grading.
zh: 在描述美学细节前，先定义一位虚构成年身份、具体成年年龄、清晰双眼要求、完整头顶与下巴边界，以及不使用真人参考。
使用简洁无缝影棚背景、小而克制的色板、宽柔暖主光和仅足以保留轮廓的冷边光；以材质证据而非泛化精致词建立真实感。
明确可检查的皮肤、胡须和服装细节，例如毛孔、淡眼下纹理、单根胡须、磨毛棉布、针织罗纹和缝线。
让人像保持观察式、无品牌表达；排除墨镜、珠宝、广告化摆拍、美颜磨皮和夸张调色。

use_when.en: Use for a calm photorealistic indoor portrait of one fictional adult seated on the floor, where complete hands, knees, posture, modest layered wardrobe, negative space, and real textile and wall materials need to remain readable.
use_when.zh: 用于需要一位虚构成年人落地坐姿的安静写实室内人像，并要求完整双手、双膝、姿态、端庄叠穿、留白以及真实织物与墙面材质都清楚可读。

en: State that the subject is a fictional adult and specify complete crown, face, shoulders, torso, hands, knees, and their floor-contact relationships before describing mood.
Use a minimal wall-and-floor set, offset the subject slightly, and reserve a calm negative-space field so the pose remains legible rather than crowded.
Name individual hand actions, opaque layered garments, and material evidence such as knit ribs, cotton weave, cuff folds, seams, plaster variation, and contact wrinkles.
Keep the treatment observed and non-sexualized: exclude youthification, revealing styling, furniture, brand language, glamour retouching, and heavy haze.
zh: 在描述情绪前，先明确主体是虚构成年人，并指定完整头顶、面部、肩部、躯干、双手、双膝及其与地面的接触关系。
使用极简墙面与地面场景，让主体轻微偏离中心并保留安静留白，使姿态清楚而不拥挤。
明确单只手的动作、不透肤叠穿服装，以及针织罗纹、棉布纹理、袖口褶皱、缝线、灰泥变化和接触褶皱等材质证据。
保持观察式、非性感化表达：排除幼态化、暴露穿搭、家具、品牌话术、美颜精修和浓重雾化。

use_when.en: Use for an industrial-design concept board that must explain one original product's form study, iteration, viewing logic, structure intent, and material direction without claiming validated engineering.
use_when.zh: 用于需要说明一个原创产品的形态研究、迭代、视图逻辑、结构意图和材质方向，同时不宣称工程验证的工业设计概念板。

en: Lock one original concept identity and repeat its defining geometry consistently across the hero, evolution, orthographic-intent, structure, and material views.
Separate concept communication from engineering authority: remove unsupported dimensions, tolerances, anthropometric figures, blueprint language, and validation claims.
Use a disciplined modular grid, a large resolved hero, an ordered evolution strip, and only a small set of readable stage labels; reject tiny body copy and pseudo-text.
Make structure and material panels visually plausible but label the entire artifact as concept-only unless verified source data exists.
zh: 锁定一个原创概念身份，并在英雄图、形态演化、视图意图、结构和材质方案中一致重复其关键几何。
将概念表达与工程权威分离：删除未经支持的尺寸、公差、人体测量数字、蓝图措辞和验证声明。
使用克制的模块网格、大幅完成态主图、有序演化条和少量可读阶段标签；拒绝微小正文和伪文字。
结构与材质面板应在视觉上可信，但除非存在已验证源数据，否则整张图必须明确标为仅限概念。

use_when.en: Use for a photorealistic performance-reference board where one fictional young Asian adult identity, camera, light, hair, and wardrobe must remain stable while only subtle facial action changes across equal cells.
use_when.zh: 用于需要在多个等比例人像格中保持同一虚构亚洲年轻成年身份、机位、光线、发型和服装稳定，仅让细微面部动作变化的写实表演参考板。

en: Lock a concise fictional adult identity before naming emotions: age, face geometry, one asymmetry marker, hair, clothing, crop, backdrop, and light.
Translate each emotion into observable eyelid, brow, gaze, mouth-corner, lip-pressure, cheek, and jaw cues instead of relying on abstract emotion adjectives.
Use a strict equal-cell grid and state that facial expression is the sole intended variable; keep head angle, shoulder scale, lens, catchlights, and exposure fixed.

Review every cell in sequence for identity continuity, expression legibility, natural skin, and restrained acting; keep labels out of the generated image unless deterministic typography is added later.
zh: 在命名情绪前锁定精简的虚构成年身份：年龄、面部几何、一个不对称标记、发型、服装、裁切、背景和光线。
把每种情绪转成可观察的眼睑、眉部、视线、嘴角、唇部压力、面颊和下颌线索，而不是只依赖抽象情绪词。
使用严格的等格网格，并明确面部表情是唯一允许变化的变量；固定头部角度、肩部比例、镜头、眼部高光和曝光。
按顺序逐格检查身份连续性、表情可读性、自然肤质和克制表演；除非后续使用确定性排版，否则不在生成图中加入标签。

title.zh: 电影式情绪转折三联画

use_when.en: Use for a photorealistic three-frame story beat where one fictional young Asian adult identity, wardrobe, camera, setting, and light must remain continuous while a restrained emotional transition unfolds.
use_when.zh: 用于需要在三个连续画面中保持同一虚构亚洲年轻成年身份、服装、镜头、场景和光线连续，同时推进克制情绪转折的写实叙事三联画。

en: Define one continuous scene and one fictional adult identity before describing the emotional arc; lock a visible asymmetry marker, hair, wardrobe, seat or support, camera, and motivated light.
Translate each beat into small observable changes in eye aperture, gaze height, inner-brow tension, lip separation, jaw set, breath, and shoulder release.
Use equal sequential frames with a stable facial axis, crop, focal length, background geometry, exposure, and color so the artifact reads as time rather than three unrelated portraits.
Keep the final beat emotionally truthful: composure may retain sadness or tension and must not default to a smile, triumph, glamour pose, or campaign finish.
zh: 在描述情绪弧线前，先锁定一个连续场景和一个虚构成年身份，并明确可见不对称标记、发型、服装、座位或支撑、镜头和有动机的光线。
把每个情绪节点转成眼睛开合、视线高度、内眉张力、嘴唇分离、下颌、呼吸和肩部释放等细小可观察变化。
使用等宽连续画面，并固定面部轴线、裁切、焦段、背景几何、曝光和色彩，使作品读成时间推进而不是三张无关人像。
保持最终节点的情绪真实：镇定仍可保留悲伤或紧张，不应默认变成微笑、胜利、广告姿态或宣传式收尾。

use_when.en: Use for a believable photographic portrait that must preserve a fictional character's identity and wardrobe without looking like cosplay or concept art.
use_when.zh: 用于将原创虚构角色转化为可信摄影肖像，同时保持身份和服装，不呈现为角色扮演或概念图。

en: Declare the reference role and list identity and wardrobe invariants explicitly.
Use plausible camera, light, material wear, skin texture, and environmental context.
Keep hands, gaze, pose, and spatial skin color within the review checklist.
For canvas correction, isolate the edit to outpainting and preserve the subject exactly.
zh: 明确参考图角色，并逐项列出身份和服装不变量。
使用可信的相机、光线、材质磨损、皮肤纹理和环境语境。
将手部、视线、姿势和空间肤色纳入独立检查项。
修正画布时只扩展环境，并严格保持人物不变。
